# Epigram

> Open-Source, Free, and AI-Powered News in Short. Epigram uses AI to deliver quick, clear summaries from reliable sources, so you get the news without the overwhelm.

Epigram is an open-source web application that simplifies how you stay informed. It combines AI-powered summaries with trusted sources to create a news feed tailored to your interests.

## Features

- Personalized news feed: a curated feed based on your preferences and interests.
- AI-powered summaries: concise news summaries and in-depth analysis.
- Trusted sources: news from reputable sources worldwide.
- User-friendly interface: a sleek, intuitive reading experience.
- Responsive design: works on desktop and mobile, with add-to-home-screen support.
- AI deep dive: in-depth AI analysis of individual news articles.

## Tech Stack

- Next.js (React) web framework
- AI SDK with OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) for summaries and analysis
- Exa for news discovery
- Mediastack for news data
- Upstash Redis for caching and rate limiting

## API Endpoints

- GET /api/news: fetches the latest AI-summarized news feed.
- POST /api/news/ai-insights: generates deeper AI analysis for an individual story.
